rules.name: Modbus Command Injection
rules.description: Industrial Control Systems and Operational Technology attack detection
rules.query: SELECT "siem_ics_ot_ics_ot_107", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%modbus%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%command%') AND "value" > 0
